# Sterling 1966 IRIS waveform cache

Placeholder. Sterling 1966 predates the IRIS open-data window. The
Sterling decoupled spectrum is a well-known low-frequency
decoupling-factor measurement (Patton 1991 Figure 6); a fetcher
that ingests digitized values into the FSRM cache layout is a future
contribution.

## Event metadata

- USGS event: us1966.12.03
- Origin time (UTC): 1966-12-03 15:00:00
- Hypocenter: 31.14 N, 89.57 W (Tatum Salt Dome, Lamar County, MS)
- Yield: 0.38 kt (decoupled in Salmon-generated cavity)
